description: This file contains functions for generating a report on incorrect serial number valuation in stock, including data retrieval, processing, and validation logic.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves stock ledger entries, prepares serial numbers, and filters incorrect serial data.

methods.name: prepare_serial_nos
methods.description: Prepares serial number-wise data from stock ledger entries.

methods.name: get_incorrect_serial_nos
methods.description: Identifies and aggregates data with incorrect serial number information.

methods.name: check_incorrect_serial_data
methods.description: Checks if serial data is inconsistent based on quantity and valuation rate.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report output.
